It's worth noting that we're incorporating some aspects from previous instruments that are felt to be important locally. Decisions by the City of Greater Geelong can only be made in two ways, and that's the resolution of Council. Pardon me. The CEO and Councillors have clear delineations of responsibilities. It's important that we get this balance right, and we ensure that it's as clear and unambiguous as possible to ensure good governance and transparency, which we've already talked about this evening. So examples of decisions that can be delegated to the CEO are things like contracts under $2 million or budget expenditure over this amount, but that has already been approved by Council. Limitations include prevention of the CEO approving or amending the Council plan. That's something Councillors have to do, or electing the mayor. So like the other documents discussed this evening, it provides a very sound foundation, but it needs to be enacted appropriately.
